items.rationale: Accept easy. Storm, lightning and thunder are familiar atmospheric phenomena; the Moon is an astronomical body beyond the atmosphere. The exact group label avoids claiming that every storm includes thunder or that the Moon cannot appear during daytime. Lightning and thunder are related but remain separate visual and sound phenomena, each satisfying the same predicate. A broad sky theme includes all four, yet does not defeat the narrower, uniquely defensible atmospheric trio. NWS explains thunder as atmospheric air expansion; NASA identifies the Moon as a natural satellite.

Accept easy. Dog-cat provides an immediate familiar-pet anchor, wheat-flour a recognizable milling relation, banana-fruit a food classification, and leaf-branch a plant attachment. Leaf and fruit can both associate with a branch, but swapping them leaves banana with leaf, which has no equally direct meaning. Wheat is a plant and flour a food, yet alternative taxonomy swaps leave the plant-part pair unmatched. The qualifying labels avoid saying all leaves grow on branches or all flour comes from wheat. No specialist or culture-specific knowledge is required; exactly one complete human and native matching is defensible.
